comments.comment: The change deleted the finally block that removed the worktree, so a task that throws leaves its worktree registered and on disk.
comments.failureScenario: lintCommit runs Biome with a two-minute timeout. On a commit where Biome runs longer, run rejects, the task throws, and inWorktree rejects before git worktree remove runs, so the review-* worktree stays in git worktree list and on disk; every timed-out lint adds one more. The base removed it in a finally block.
